domain：recruitment_fraud
audit_goal：Assess recruitment advance fees and fabricated job offers from the supplied evidence.
允许的风险类别（category_id｜name）：
recruitment.advance_fee｜Advance fees
recruitment.fake_offer｜Fabricated offers
筛选后的业务规则：
recruitment.fee_request｜参考 high｜Require an applicant to transfer a deposit before receiving a job offer.
recruitment.unclear_fee｜参考 low｜An ambiguous service fee is mentioned without a payment request.
t 仅使用上述 category_id。“参考”只用于研判；实际 risk_level 仅依据当前评论证据，不得代填；s 按 none=0、low=40、medium=60、high=80 输出。

规则级豁免仅在实际满足时使用：recruitment.refund｜The record only documents returning a previously collected fee.
